sentences.text: Dead reckoning follows a few standard rules.
Plot a DR position every hour on the hour, at every change of course or speed, at the time of every fix or running fix, and at the time you obtain a single line of position.
Whenever you get a fix, start a new DR track from it, because the fix is better information than your old DR.
These rules come from Bowditch, the standard navigation reference, and exam problems follow them.
